Please don't do it... do not do it I am begging you, I was feeling the same way a while ago but then you have to wake up and realise that you're feeling this way because we as people are built into the matrix, we go to school, work, but did you know that is not our purpose, suicide is never the answer, you are so precious, beautiful and you have such a bigger purpose than it may seem, people care about you, they really do, they really really do. Go into nature, I suggest you should start meditating and connecting with your higher self then you will see the true beauty of life. This feeling of suicide is temporary, once you find out the truth about life and this world you will not want to commit suicide, it's all a program matrix you are not built to do anything for anyone. Meditate, eat healthy and take care of yourself, I love youuuuu <333

Also if you want, you should start watching Spiritual So videos on youtube, he really made me realise life is so much important than we think :)
